items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: In this band, all these fellows were very good musicians ... Frank [Paylsey] turned around and looked at me ... And all the band jumped up

ctx.x: musicians, but I guess being a young man, you're always impressed by the guy that really stays on you the most.

In this band, all these fellows were very good musicians -- and I never will forget that at rehearsal, we were taking something down, some arrangement Buck had made, and there was -- you know a dotted quarter or something; I probably played it as a straight quarter, and Frank [Paylsey] turned around and looked at me and said, "You little young S.O.B. -- read your music!" You know ... and I jumped up and said, "Nobody calls me an S.O.B.!" And all the band jumped up and said, "You 13 of them, so sit down and play…
And they really had me in tears, you know, because I hadn't been used to the rough stuff that they were laying on me, but ...
